title: Obsidian search
description: Find a note in your Obsidian vault by its title or by what it says, without opening Obsidian first.
examples: Type pilot spec: notes titled with those words first, then notes that mention them, each with the line that matched; Return opens it in Obsidian
Cmd+K on a note: preview it, copy its [[wikilink]] or path, or show it in Finder

preferences.name: vault
preferences.title: Vault folder
preferences.description: Empty: the vault Obsidian opened last. Hidden folders such as .obsidian and .trash are skipped.
